summary: @servicetitan/anvil-css-utilities preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a CSS utilities library but declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (`https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<platform>.zip`) into a temporary directory, unzips it, marks it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` to run a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle with a rotated string-array decoder (functions such as `WV8StW` rotating `n7gIxM`, and a custom-alphabet decoder `hc1jfK9`) and hex-mangled identifiers; its contents are opaque and unrelated to CSS. The file is not listed in `package.json` `files` (which declares only `dist` and `readme.md`). `setup.mjs` itself uses `_0x`-prefixed identifiers and per-function property-bag literals (e.g. `_0x19328d.YCZJE(execFileSync, 'ldd',...)`) to indirect calls and hide constants including the Bun download URL and platform selectors. On `npm install`, this preinstall path executes attacker-authored, obfuscated code on the installer's host through a second language runtime that a CSS utilities package has no legitimate reason to install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
